info.name: Stock Management System API
info.description: Complete Postman collection for Stock Management System API. Includes Authentication, RBAC, Users, Products, Variants, Approval Workflow, Direct Operations, Excel Import/Export, Stock Adjustments, Notifications, and Reports.

item.description: User login, password changes, token refresh, and session logout.

request.description: Authenticates a user with staffId and password. Automatically stores accessToken and refreshToken into collection variables.

Changes the user's password. Clears mustChangePassword flag on first login.
Revokes the session and active refresh token.
